[id="deleting-a-cached-model_{context}"]
= Delete a cached model

[role="_abstract"]
You can delete a cached model to reclaim storage space on your nodes.
When you delete a `LocalModelCache` resource, the controller schedules cleanup operations to remove the model files.
The cleanup process differs depending on whether you cached the model on local node disks or network volumes.

.Prerequisites

* You have cluster administrator privileges for your {openshift-platform} cluster.
* You have identified the `LocalModelCache` resource to delete.
* No active `InferenceService` or `LLMInferenceService` references the cached model.
+
The controller rejects deletion if the model is in use by an active inference service.

.Procedure

. Verify that no active inference service uses the cached model:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get localmodelcache <model_cache_name> -o jsonpath='{.status.inferenceServices}'
----
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get localmodelcache <model_cache_name> -o jsonpath='{.status.llmInferenceServices}'
----
+
Both commands should return empty lists.
If either command returns inference service references, update or delete those inference services before continuing.

. Delete the `LocalModelCache` resource:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc delete localmodelcache <model_cache_name>
----
+
The controller handles cleanup differently based on the caching mode:
+
--
* *Local disk caching*: The controller creates deletion jobs on each node to remove model files from the local storage path.
Monitor the `storageStatus` field to track per-node cleanup progress.
* *Network volume caching*: The controller deletes the persistent volume claims.
The persistent volume cleanup follows the reclaim policy of the `StorageClass`.
If the reclaim policy is `Retain`, you must manually delete the persistent volumes after the persistent volume claims are removed.
--

. Wait for the deletion to complete and verify that the controller has cleaned up the persistent volumes and persistent volume claims:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get pv -l localmodel.kserve.io/model=<model_cache_name>
----
+
The command should return no results after the cleanup completes.

. For network volume caching with a `Retain` reclaim policy, manually delete any remaining persistent volumes:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc delete pv <pv_name>
----

.Troubleshooting

If the deletion is stuck and the `LocalModelCache` resource is not removed:

* Verify that no `InferenceService` or `LLMInferenceService` references the model.
If a reference exists, the finalizer on the `LocalModelCache` resource prevents deletion.
+
Remove or update the inference service, then the controller removes the finalizer and completes the deletion.

* Check the deletion job logs for errors:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get jobs -n <job_namespace> -l localmodel.kserve.io/model=<model_cache_name>
----
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc logs job/<deletion_job_name> -n <job_namespace>
----
